description: "Undelete and Disable References" on DLCRobot.esm with the options of the Cleaning tab away from their defaults: no player enable parent (UDRSetXESP off) and a height of -20000 for the references that are not persistent (UDRSetZValue). UDRSetScale stays off here: seven of the references take a scale back from Fallout4.esm, and the release's scale step leaves such a scale alone and writes the value into the element of the reference before (an upstream bug the port does not reproduce; fo3-udr-options covers the scale over references without one).
